text:
Jonas Reed: Heads-up: Tideway wants to migrate from HaloAPI -> Redwood. They asked for a 3-week POC to validate behavior parity (prompt/response), network peering, and an initial migration cost model. Can SE + infra pick this up?
Maya Singh: I'll coordinate SE work. Key asks from their infra doc: static egress IPs, KMS integration, and 12-month audit log retention. Also they need example parity tests for our chat and completion endpoints.
Teo Alvarez: SE plan: create a small corpus (50 prompts) covering summarization, style-transfer, and troubleshooting flows. We'll run A/B against their Halo baseline and produce a 'delta heatmap' of token/response differences. Need their sample responses and whether they use session cookies for state.
Samir Khan: Re: cost model and billing mismatch: Halo rounds tokens to 25-token increments; we bill exact tokens. For short-turn traffic this makes a noticeable difference. I'll prepare three scenarios (stateless light, stateful medium, high-volume) and show monthly delta.
Hannah Cole: Security intake: send the security questionnaire + our SOC2 summary. Also Tideway requires private link peering rather than shared VPN. Ops, can we support that for a short-lived dev env?
ops-bot: Dev environment request received: tideway-poc -> provisioning in queue. ETA 36h for peering setup once CIDR and contact window provided.
Jonas Reed: I've uploaded the prompt corpus to the shared drive: https://redwood.app/shared/tideway/prompt-corpus-2026-03-23.txt
Maya Singh: Great. Tideway provided three representative HaloAPI responses for prompt #3 (troubleshooting):
```json
{"id":"msg_77","output":"Restart the service, check disk, escalate to infra","entities":["service","disk"]}
```
Teo Alvarez: Running initial diff now. Quick note: HaloAPI injects an extra trailing newline and returns entity labels as lowercase; our model uses TitleCase. We'll normalize case in the harness but flag semantic deltas.
Samir Khan: Pricing draft: assuming 1M tokens/month baseline, projected monthly delta = +$320 (Halo rounding) vs -$45 (our optimized batching) depending on routing policy. I'll send the sheet.
Hannah Cole: On KMS: Tideway expects customer-managed keys for encryption at rest. We support BYOK via our KMS integration, but need SOW to enable it in Private mode. For POC we can enable envelope encryption with their keys in dev.
Maya Singh: Network ask: Tideway's infra team needs our dev pool egress IPs and a peering maintenance window (2h). Teo / ops, please share the IP block and proposed time.
ops-bot: Reserved egress IPs: 54.182.11.200 - 54.182.11.203 (tideway-poc). Please coordinate maintenance 03/25 01:00-03:00 UTC.
Teo Alvarez: Diff summary (initial): 50 prompts run vs Halo baseline. 42 exact-match text bodies after whitespace normalization; 6 minor tokenization differences (punctuation spacing) and 2 semantic discrepancies on multi-turn context prompts. I'll attach the CSV in the drive.
Samir Khan: I'll model two pricing options in the shared sheet: pay-as-you-go vs reserved-committed 6mo. For >5M tokens/month reserved looks ~18% cheaper.
Jonas Reed: Blocker: Tideway legal requested our DPA + pen-test report before we ingest any sample production logs. Hannah, can you push those docs to them?
Hannah Cole: Sent SOC2 summary and previous pen-test redacted report to their security rep. Waiting for confirmation.
Maya Singh: Next steps checklist: 1) SE finish full diff + tokenized delta, 2) Ops finalize peering + IP allowlist, 3) Security deliver docs, 4) Finance produce pricing scenarios, 5) Schedule mid-POC review week 2.
Jonas Reed: Meeting set: Tue 10:00 PT for mid-POC review. Please add action owners in the shared sheet. :calendar:
